Use case: stylized-concept. Production full-body frame-by-frame 2D metroidvania MOVE ATTACK sprites. REFERENCE 1 is the approved RUN animation: preserve its low forward lean, giant round ivory head with single black oval eye, compact short arms and legs, plain shorts, long softly flowing layered paper cloak, subtle matte paper texture, thin dark warm outline. REFERENCE 2 is the approved running pose enlarged. REFERENCE 3 is standing attack ONLY for eraser appearance and attack arc; do NOT copy its upright stationary stance. Create a NEW 3 columns x 2 rows equal-cell sprite sheet, SIX WHOLE-BODY moving attack frames, read left-right top-bottom, on TRUE transparent RGBA background. 1536x1024 canvas, each cell512x512. Keep every full sprite and arc within its cell, with 35px blank margin on all four sides! Head diameter about150px SAME size in all six. Face always right, one black eye, no mouth or nose, no redesign. Body stays low and tilted 25-35 degrees forward throughout, head leading hips, knees always bent. Arms remain short, one hand holding a small blunt ivory rectangular ERASER, NO sword, no handle. Cloak/shorts 10% darker than body, distant leg noticeably darker warm grey, near leg ivory. Cape streams backward left, broad rounded waves, not spikes. This is continuous RUNNING while striking: the feet must exchange roles; no standing planted lunge repeated in all cells. No pieces/rigs, no fake motion by sliding one unchanged standing pose.
Six leg poses IN ORDER (near = bright, far = dark): 1 bright near knee forward, bright sole lands under chest, dark far leg bent behind; 2 bright near foot travels BACK under hips pushing ground, dark far knee swings forward folded; 3 dark far knee leads forward and lowers, bright near leg bends behind (brief airborne passage, not a high jump); 4 dark far sole lands under chest with bent knee, bright near leg folds behind; 5 dark far foot pushes BACK beneath hip, bright near knee comes forward folded; 6 bright near knee leads forward ready to land, dark far leg bends behind. Transparent alpha zero outside silhouettes, no background, glow, floor, cast shadow, text, grid or labels. Soft illustrated paper texture like reference, NOT pixel art or 3D. Exactly six complete distinct drawings, no overlapping cells.

The eraser continuously travels through a clear path, while the legs perform the specified alternating gait.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a game animation sprite sheet, 1536x1024 transparent RGBA, exactly 3 columns x 2 rows of equal 512x512 cells, 6 full-body hand-drawn poses in chronological reading order, no labels or grid. Reference is this exact hero and the end of attack 2. Preserve giant circular ivory paper head, black oval eye facing RIGHT, short compact limbs, plain shorts, soft layered paper cape, cream shading, delicate dark outline. Existing weapon is a small blunt rectangular cream eraser held in fist, never a blade. Same hero scale in every cell: head diameter around180px; whole figure within cell with at least24px margin, foot baseline y460. Third attack is a HORIZONTAL FORWARD THRUST, never an overhead slash. Short anatomically bent elbow then extend toward right chest-height; arm must stay compact, no rubber limbs. Cape trails left. No circular slash arcs, at most a short narrow horizontal smear behind the eraser in frame3. Pose1: begin exactly with the reference raised/back weapon arm pose, continuing the upward second attack. Pose2: lower eraser to near chest, elbow tucked and hand pulled back to prepare thrust. Pose3: quick forward horizontal thrust in progress. Pose4: fully extended forward thrust, blunt eraser front face pointing right, body leaning into it. Pose5: retract eraser on same horizontal line halfway to chest. Pose6: retract hand into cloak and settle. All six poses isolated with fully transparent background. No ground, shadows, text, watermark, extra limbs. MOVING attack version: preserve forward low running silhouette from reference and compact limbs. All six poses run toward RIGHT while thrusting. Alternate bright near leg and darker far leg.
